scripts.docker:build: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down && docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build
scripts.docker:services-rebuild: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml stop libs-builder identity-service product-service user-service shop-service storefront-service && docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml rm -f libs-builder identity-service product-service user-service shop-service storefront-service && docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml build --no-cache libs-builder identity-service product-service user-service shop-service storefront-service && docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d libs-builder identity-service product-service user-service shop-service storefront-service
scripts.docker:services-restart: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml restart libs-builder identity-service product-service user-service shop-service storefront-service
scripts.typecheck: cd libs && bunx tsc --noEmit && cd ../identity && bunx tsc --noEmit && cd ../product && bunx tsc --noEmit && cd ../user && bunx tsc --noEmit && cd ../shop && bunx tsc --noEmit && cd ../storefront && bunx tsc --noEmit
scripts.pre-commit: bun run lint && bun run typecheck
